name: Celtic Coaches Convention
shortDescription: Join an elite coaching experience at Celtic FC’s 2026 Coaches Convention—immerse in world-class training, tactical innovation, and exclusive access to Celtic’s academy and first-team environment.
programOverview:
Step into the world of elite coaching at the Celtic International Coaches Convention — a unique opportunity to immerse yourself in the traditions and cutting-edge methods of Celtic FC. Over several inspiring days in Glasgow, you’ll gain first-hand insight into how a top-tier club develops talent, with exclusive behind-the-scenes access and expert-led sessions designed to elevate your coaching journey.

As your travel partner, we ensure your experience is seamless and comfortable. Expect high-quality accommodation, full-board meals, smooth airport transfers, and ground transport — everything taken care of so you can focus on learning, networking, and growing.

Join coaches from around the world, absorb Celtic’s coaching philosophy, and return home with fresh knowledge, inspiration, and the memories of a transformative coaching trip.

• Exclusive access to Celtic’s first-team and Academy training sessions.
• Presentations and Q&A with senior and Academy coaching staff.
• Behind-the-scenes tours of Celtic Park, Lennoxtown, and Barrowfield training facilities.
• In-depth workshops on player development, sports science, and match analysis.
• Comfortable full-board accommodation, airport transfers, and ground transport between sessions and activities.
whatsIncluded: High quality accommodation and full-board meals.
Airport transfers and ground transport betrween hotel and all sessions and activities.
Entrance to National Football Museum.
Exclusive access to Celtic FC first-team and Academy training sessions
Presentations and Q&A with Celtic’s senior and Academy coaching staff
Behind-the-scenes tours of Celtic Park, Lennoxtown, and Barrowfield training facilities
In-depth workshops on player development, sports science, and match analysis
Observation of live Academy fixtures and post-match debriefs
Insights into recruitment, performance pathways, and youth development philosophy
Networking sessions with coaches from around the world
Hospitality access on matchday, including pre- and post-game experiences
Tour Director support throughout for logistics and coordination.

developmentFocus.academyVisits: All Axis Football Tours Coach Education experiences are carefully designed to partner with leading academies that offer the greatest learning opportunities. Coaches gain invaluable insights into elite player development within a supportive, zero-pressure environment, encouraging open discussion, shared learning, and genuine growth ensuring every participant leaves inspired, informed, and more confident in their coaching journey.
developmentFocus.clinics: The on-field practical clinics are delivered to the highest professional standards by expert coaches and accomplished presenters. Each session is fully interactive, encouraging participation, discussion, and real-time feedback—ensuring every coach can engage directly, ask the questions that matter most, and gain maximum benefit from every practical learning opportunity.
developmentFocus.workshopSessions: The classroom workshops provide an in-depth exploration of every stage of the player development pathway—covering technical, tactical, physical, and psycho-social aspects of the game. Led by experienced educators, these interactive sessions encourage open discussion, critical thinking, and collaboration, ensuring every coach gains meaningful, practical insights to enhance their own coaching environment.
developmentFocus.qaSessions: The Q&A sessions are a standout feature of every Axis Football Tours Coach Education experience. Carefully selected guest speakers—ranging from top academy directors to experienced professional managers—share genuine insights in an intimate, relaxed setting. These interactive discussions allow coaches to ask meaningful questions, exchange ideas, and gain valuable perspectives from the game’s most respected minds.

accommodationMealsSafety.accommodation:
With Axis Football Tours, every detail of your stay is designed to match the prestige of your football experience. We’ve partnered with a handpicked collection of exceptional hotels across the globe — each offering first-class comfort, style, and amenities perfectly suited to your team’s needs.

Our accommodations are carefully selected for their prime locations — whether steps away from elite training facilities or set within resort-style complexes offering outstanding sports and leisure options. Every property meets our rigorous standards for quality, safety, and service, ensuring a seamless and inspiring experience from check-in to check-out.

We believe your surroundings should elevate your performance. That’s why we exclusively feature premium 3 and 4-star hotels, chosen to provide superior comfort and a touch of luxury throughout your tour.

Typically based on 2–4 persons sharing, your full-board package includes delicious, nutritious meals — with lunches served at the hotel or training complex, and evening dining experiences either at your accommodation or a quality local restaurant. (Comparable alternatives may occasionally be used if your featured hotel is unavailable.)
accommodationMealsSafety.meals: We have half and full board options for travelling groups depending on your needs. We recommend the full board for most of our groups knowing that you have everything taken care of on site.
accommodationMealsSafety.playerSafety: We only work with accredited partners ensuring you have a safe and stress-free tour. Risk assessments are completed for all our tours and support is provided 24/7 by our team and on the ground with your very own Tour Director.

name: GotSport European Coach Education Tour - London 2026
shortDescription: In partnership with GotSport, experience London through the lens of elite football development. This exclusive coach education tour combines professional academy visits, expert-led learning, and access to Premier League and Championship football, providing ambitious club leaders with practical insights, new perspectives, and unforgettable experiences to take back to their clubs.
programOverview:
Step into the world of elite football development on the GotSport x Axis Football London Coach Education Experience — a unique opportunity to immerse yourself in the environments, methods, and culture of professional academies in one of the world’s great football cities. Over 9 inspiring days in London, you’ll gain first-hand insight into how elite clubs develop players, coaches, and leaders, with access to academy environments, practical on-field learning, expert-led workshops, professional match experiences, and behind-the-scenes football moments designed to elevate your coaching journey.

As your travel partner, Axis Football Co ensures your experience is seamless, professional, and comfortable. Expect quality accommodation, airport transfers, local transportation, academy visits, match tickets, cultural experiences, and dedicated tour support — everything taken care of, so you can focus on learning, connecting, and bringing fresh ideas back to your club.

Join a select group of only 20 coaches, experience London through the lens of elite football development, and return home with practical knowledge, powerful new relationships, and the inspiration to make a lasting impact in your club environment.

Academy visits and practical sessions at Arsenal FC, Queens Park Rangers FC, and Charlton Athletic FC Interactive workshops covering talent ID, curriculum, pedagogy, methodology, coach development, and leadership Live youth match observation, game insight, and guided analysis Tickets to two professional matches and a Champions League watch party experience Wembley Tour, Arsenal Stadium Tour, London sightseeing, museum visit, airport transfers, accommodation, and full tour support

itinerary.title: Arrival + Orientation
itinerary.description: Arrive London, meet Tour Director at airport and transfer to hotel. Hotel check-in and tour briefing. Workshop 1: Goal Setting. Practical Coaching Sessions 1 & 2 at Queens Park Rangers FC Academy.

itinerary.title: Talent Identification & Recruitment
itinerary.description: Breakfast at hotel. Workshops 2 & 3: Recruitment, Retention and Talent Identification. Free time to explore London. Practical Coaching Sessions 3 & 4 at Charlton Athletic FC Academy.

itinerary.title: Curriculum & Pedagogy
itinerary.description: Breakfast at hotel. Workshops 4 & 5: Curriculum Design and Pedagogy. Wembley Stadium Tour. Q&A with a former professional manager. Champions League Watch Party.

itinerary.title: London Experience
itinerary.description: Breakfast at hotel. Guided London sightseeing experience. Free evening to explore the city.

itinerary.title: Methodology & Academy Practice
itinerary.description: Breakfast at hotel. Workshops 6 & 7: Methodology, Player Development and Team Context. Arsenal Stadium Tour. Practical Coaching Sessions 5 & 6 at Arsenal FC Academy.

itinerary.title: Leadership & Coach Development
itinerary.description: Breakfast at hotel. Workshops 8 & 9: Coach Development and Leadership. Attend a professional football match. Workshop review, awards ceremony and social event.

itinerary.title: Professional Football Experience
itinerary.description: Breakfast at hotel. Attend professional football matches and experience elite matchday environments. Free evening

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Breakfast at hotel. Hotel check-out. Airport transfer and departure flight home.
